summary: Ambev S.A. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 14, 2026, furnishing its internal Manual on Disclosure and Use of Information and Securities Trading Policy. The manual establishes disclosure standards, insider trading restrictions, blackout periods, and procedures for communicating material acts or facts under Brazilian CVM rules. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure by the foreign private issuer, not a special situation. The filing contains no transaction, no M&A, no tender offer, and no management change. The registrant acts only as a filer reporting standard policy documents. Nothing in the text suggests a special-situation event, and the appropriate classification is 'None'.
